Cannon Materials Sheet v1.0 - Beta version 0.1.0 by Fallout
18
19
Notes:
What are the percentages and how were they calculated?
20
Each cannon was crafted with all of the same Q10 metals in every slot but one. The slot being tested was then compared against the best performer of that slot.
21
Example: A Lead barrel resulted in 72 power, and a Steel barrel 79 power, which was the highest of all the barrels. I subtracted the base power (51) from all the results, and was left with 28 from Steel, and 21 for Lead.
22
So Steel being the highest in the group, it's power of 28 is counted as the 100% mark, and a Lead barrel gained 75% of the highest mark.
23
24
Why not list the flat numbers?
25
The flat numbers would only matter on cannon blueprints with a base of 51 power. Also they would be misleading because it is impossible to completely isolate the bonus of a single part.
26
Because each stat is affected by 2 different parts on the cannon, (Power is controlled by both Barrel and Firing Mechanism), there will always be 2 unknown variables in each test.
27
If you'd like to see the raw numbers, I screenshotted each cannon crafted and provided the data in the other sheets.
